name: My New Band Believe
label: Rough Trade
lede: Cameron Picton wrote a band name down in a food-poisoning haze on a black midi tour of China, then built an acoustic record on Rough Trade that Pitchfork scored 8.4, with a lineup that changes from song to song.

eras.title: Four BRIT School kids and a Brixton pub
eras.text: Cameron Picton, Geordie Greep, Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin and Morgan Simpson all went to the BRIT School and started black midi in a Brixton pub. Picton played bass and sang. By the end of 2019 they had a Rough Trade deal and a Mercury Prize nomination.

years.h: First gig at the Windmill, supporting Leg Puppy
years.p: [[black midi|4afbef0a-05ee-4551-b0e0-f1f1870d8f1c]] played their first show at a south London pub in Brixton, the room the press later turned into the "Windmill scene".
years.xp: All four members ([[Geordie Greep|6ca6f49f-41f3-49ae-8403-44d07bc6f564]], Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin, [[Morgan Simpson|c3136ee8-f5b8-491e-acaa-60dda80e8eb1]] and Cameron Picton) went to the BRIT School. Wikipedia dates the band's formation to 2016: Greep and Kwasniewski-Kelvin recruited Simpson on drums, and Picton joined on bass afterward.

years.src: KEXP: black midi · Wikipedia: Black Midi
years.h: Reykjavik, KEXP and a YouTube clip that tours for them
years.p: black midi played Iceland Airwaves on November 9, 2018, and the recording of the set was passing around YouTube before they had an album out.
years.xp: Their debut single, bmbmbm, had come out on June 8, 2018 on [[Dan Carey|41b34054-f491-4991-9495-477617fdc81a]]'s Speedy Wunderground label. Wikipedia says the KEXP session "became popular on YouTube" and put the band in front of listeners abroad.

years.p: The debut album followed a January 2019 signing to the label that would later release Picton's own band, and drew a Mercury Prize nomination.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists the album at 82 on Metacritic and as a 2019 Mercury Prize nominee.

eras.title: Cavalcade, Hellfire, one guitarist down
eras.text: Kwasniewski-Kelvin stepped back and black midi carried on without him. Picton's part on record grew well beyond bass, and Cavalcade and Hellfire are where you can hear it.

years.h: Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin steps back from black midi
years.p: The band said the guitarist was taking time off for mental health reasons and would not be on new material.
years.xp: He still composed on some songs for Cavalcade, released May 26, 2021, with touring players [[Seth Evans|f97a5613-eb6f-44bf-a238-4adf26aa7b06]] and Kaidi Akinnibi in the sessions. Wikipedia credits Picton with bass, vocals, flute, keyboards and guitar on that record.

years.h: Hellfire gives black midi their best UK chart run
years.p: The third album entered at No. 22 in the UK and No. 139 in the US, according to Wikipedia. It turned out to be the last.

eras.title: Nobody says the word breakup
eras.text: A sick bassist wrote a band name down, sold his first solo mixtapes at merch tables, and watched black midi go quiet without a funeral. By the end of 2024 Greep and Simpson had projects of their own.

years.big: You got to suffer to have nice things
years.src: Paste · The Quietus · Rough Trade: My New Band Believe announce
years.h: A Xi'an hotel room, a food-poisoning haze, a band name
years.p: Picton told Paste the phrase "My New Band Believe" came to him after he ate street crayfish on tour in China.
years.xp: The Quietus has him writing down a string of phrases while delirious on black midi's China tour, and one of them stuck. Rough Trade's own announcement puts him "delirious in a Chinese hotel room" when the idea hit.

years.h: Camera Picture mixtapes, sold only at the merch table
years.p: Picton began playing solo under that name, selling single-track mixtapes titled by running time. The first was 44m50s.
years.xp: DIY reports it started on an April 2024 US tour supporting [[Black Country, New Road|e9403d9c-329b-4108-a26f-564159d441d9]]. Per Wikipedia the three tapes (44m50s, 36m33s and 24m56s) were sold only at gigs, to cover studio costs. Picton said they take the pressure off releasing music officially.

years.src: Wikipedia: Black Midi · Wikipedia: Geordie Greep
years.h: Greep tells Instagram Live that black midi is "indefinitely over"
years.p: Picton confirmed it on Twitter and said the band had agreed not to say anything about "breaking up". Management called it a hiatus.
years.xp: A statement to The Quietus said the band was taking a break for solo work, with the door left open. Greep released his solo album The New Sound on October 4, 2024, produced by [[Seth Evans|f97a5613-eb6f-44bf-a238-4adf26aa7b06]], and [[Morgan Simpson|c3136ee8-f5b8-491e-acaa-60dda80e8eb1]] went out on the road with [[Nala Sinephro|46a4b150-be30-44b3-a337-e06a72657d33]].

eras.title: Eight days, one song
eras.text: The project got a name, a first single and a first show. It was never meant to be a fixed lineup, so nobody blinked when the players changed.

years.h: Lecture 25, built from Dennis Cooper's words in eight days
years.p: Picton adapted about half the lyrics from Cooper's Lecture 1970. Jack Shep directed the video.
years.xp:
Clash reports the song was conceived, recorded, mixed, mastered and filmed in a "breathless eight-day streak". Picton played guitar and sang, with Josh Finerty on bass, King David Ike-Elechi on drums and Seth Evans on piano. Evans and Margo Broom produced at RAK Studios.

Picton said he hadn't written a proper song since before Christmas and figured this was a good way to get moving again.

years.h: First show at Schubas Tavern, Chicago
years.p: Picton opened a US run there solo, selling the third Camera Picture mixtape (24m56s) at the dates and nowhere else.
years.xp: Rough Trade's announcement listed Chicago first. It also had him opening for [[Lankum|0898de3e-7045-478b-a5af-c7de9c66c86e]] on select West Coast shows in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

eras.title: Eleven studios, eight songs
eras.text: The debut came out on Rough Trade in April, after a year of stacked acoustic guitar tracks and added strings. Three months earlier, news of Kwasniewski-Kelvin's death had reached his old bandmates and everyone else.

years.p: His family said he died after a long battle with his mental health. Rough Trade shared its condolences.
years.xp: Picton told The Quietus that talking about Matt is an emotional thing, and that he had been looking back through old photos of the two of them.

years.cap: My New Band Believe with Cameron Picton, centre, c. 2026
years.src: Rough Trade: Love Story · NME · Wikipedia: My New Band Believe (album)
years.h: Love Story arrives with strings by Kiran Leonard
years.p: Parker Corey made the video. Rough Trade says Picton wrote the song quickly in early 2024, and [[Kiran Leonard|5dfe107b-b9c2-42c4-a2e6-34f056bd4563]] arranged the strings.
years.xp: NME says the piano line was improvised in the clock tower at St. Pancras station. A month earlier, on February 17, Picton had announced the album with a non-album single, Numerology, which Wikipedia says is on the deluxe editions.

years.src: Wikipedia: My New Band Believe (album) · The Label · NME · The Line of Best Fit
yt: Cameron Picton on the recording process
years.h: Eight acoustic songs, a crowd of players, Pitchfork 8.4
years.p: [[Kiran Leonard|5dfe107b-b9c2-42c4-a2e6-34f056bd4563]], [[Steve Noble|ac3495e0-c927-48e6-9499-de8c2c3c8dd8]], Caius Williams and members of caroline play on it. Sam Sodomsky's Pitchfork review gave it an 8.4.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says recording ran across 29 days between August 2024 and December 2025, in 11 London studios with 9 engineers. The band recorded songs live several times and Picton assembled the master versions from those takes instead of making demos.

NME's Patrick Clarke called it a masterpiece, and The Guardian's Alexis Petridis gave it four stars. Picton told The Line of Best Fit: "There's no cynicism or irony or anything like that. I'm very serious about it."

q: It's basically a band that doesn't really have any set members.
years.src: Northern Transmissions · Rough Trade: Love Story · The Line of Best Fit
yt: Full show, The Windmill, Brixton, May 24
years.h: "A band that doesn't really have any set members" hits the road
years.p: UK dates ran April 28 to May 6 and North American dates May 29 to June 7, with several already sold out by March.
years.xp: Rough Trade also listed Rewire in The Hague on April 11 and Green Man on August 21 to 23. The Line of Best Fit names King David Ike-Elechi, Steve Noble and Caius Williams among the live players.
